title: Force PubMed Expert
input_summary: Use pubmed-expert to find recent (2022-2025) PubMed literature on DES vs BMS in elderly STEMI patients.
sse_event_types_observed: data-json (pubmed search_results array of web_result items)

pubmed_response_structure.sample_title: A 10-year review of presentation, management and outcomes of STEMI in a high-volume regional Australian tertiary centre.

key_finding: PubMed Expert wraps a search MCP tool returning web_result items. Same event protocol as Coding Expert — only the data payload differs. CONFIRMS expert = LLM-conditional dispatch to a set of MCP tools.
key_implication: iCoDer Orchestrator Gate 3 can implement Corti parity with: (1) SSE event stream, (2) `Calling expert: <name>` status events, (3) `data-json` tool result events, (4) LLM decides when to stop calling tools and synthesize text-delta.
